message.content:
Step 1: Identify the military self-defense system developed for the Israel Defense Forces. According to the source [Krav Maga], this system is Krav Maga.
Step 2: Identify the man who created Krav Maga and is also known as Imi Sde-Or. According to the source [Imi Lichtenfeld], Emrich "Imi" Lichtenfeld founded the Krav Maga self-defense system and was also known as Imi Sde-Or.
Step 3: Provide the full legal name of this person, which is Emrich "Imi" Lichtenfeld.

Final answer: Emrich "Imi" Lichtenfeld
message.reasoning:
The question asks for the man, also known as Imi Sde-Or, who created a military self-defense system developed for the Israel Defense Forces.
Looking at the sources:
[Imi Lichtenfeld] states: Emrich "Imi" Lichtenfeld (May 26, 1910 – January 9, 1998) was a Hungarian-born Israeli martial artist who founded the Krav Maga self-defense system. He was also known as Imi Sde-Or, the Hebrew calque of his surname.
[Krav Maga] states: Krav Maga is a military self-defense system developed for the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) and Israeli security forces... It was derived from the street-fighting experience of Hungarian-Israeli martial artist Imi Lichtenfeld...

So the man is Emrich "Imi" Lichtenfeld.
The question asks for his full legal name. Emrich "Imi" Lichtenfeld.
